atomic_facts.fact: Nikola Corporation's full legal name is Nikola Corporation.
Nikola Corporation is incorporated in the State of Delaware.
Nikola Corporation's headquarters is located in Phoenix, Arizona, USA.
Nikola Corporation filed voluntary petitions for relief under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code.
The Chapter 11 petition was filed in the United States Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware.
The Chapter 11 filing occurred on February 19, 2025.
Nikola Corporation's bankruptcy case is identified by case number 25-10258 (lead case).
The case number 25-10258 confirms the filing was made in 2025 (month not specified in this source).
A liquidation plan in Nikola's Chapter 11 case was confirmed on September 12, 2025.
A Chapter 11 appeal related to Nikola Corporation was reviewed on September 10, 2026.
